title: Jordan and the Terrorist Threat of Daesh, 2003-2017
core_idea: Provide an in-depth analysis of the Daesh terrorist threat to Jordanian national security (2003–2017), focusing on its transnational threat, ideological foundations, and strategic approach toward Jordanian society, while examining country-specific geographic, economic, social, and demographic factors that relate to Daesh's targeting and recruitment of Jordanian citizens.
tldr: A descriptive analytical study using qualitative content analysis of books, newspapers, speeches, interviews, and social media to examine Daesh's transnational threat, ideology, and strategy targeting Jordan and the factors shaping that threat between 2003 and 2017.
